text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: She's a "Pace" type, just like me.

Umamusume running styles can be broadly 
split into four categories: "Front 
Runner," "Pacesetter," "Late Bloomer," and 
"Chaser"—

Among them, front-runners shape the pace 
of the race from the leading pack. Many 
have good starts and possess the stamina 
to sustain a strong finishing kick for a 
long time.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:
